chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn al-Jabbar, from Safwan, from the one who mentioned it, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

I said to him, 'Teach me something I can say when it is morning and when it is evening.' So he said, 'Say: The Praise is for Allah Who does what He wills, and He alone does not do what others will. The Praise is for Allah just as Allah loves to be praised. The Praise is for Allah just as He is worthy of it.'

O Allah, enter me into every goodness that You entered Muhammad and the Progeny of Muhammad into, and take me out from every evil that You took Muhammad and the Progeny of Muhammad out from, and send blessings upon Muhammad and the Progeny of Muhammad.
ai.seo_question: What is the morning and evening supplication taught by Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi highlights the Shia emphasis on aligning personal spiritual states with the prophetic model through specific morning and evening adhkar. The supplication uniquely combines theological affirmation of Allah's absolute will with a petition for inclusion in the specific blessings and protection granted to the Prophet and his Ahl al-Bayt, reflecting the concept of their unique status in divine favor. It serves as a daily ritual for believers to internalize gratitude and seek intercessory proximity to the Ahl al-Bayt.

en.hubeali:
Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Safwan, from the one who mentioned it, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘Teach me something I can say when it is morning and when it is evening’.

So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Say, ‘The Praise is for Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Who Does whatever He<sup>azwj</sup> so Desires to, and does not Do what others desire. The Praise is for Allah<sup>azwj</sup> just as Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Loves to be praised. The Praise is for Allah<sup>azwj</sup> just as He<sup>azwj</sup> is Rightful of it.

O Allahazwj! Enter me into every goodness wherein Youazwj Entered Muhammadsaww and the Progenyasws of Muhammadsaww into, and Keep me away from every evil which Youazwj Kept Muhammadsaww and the Progenyasws of Muhammadsaww away from, and Send Salawāts upon Muhammadsaww and the Progenyasws of Muhammadsaww’.
en.sarwar: 22. Abu Ali al-Ash’ari has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Abd al-Jabbar from Safwan from those whom he has mentioned (in his book) who has said the following:

“Once I asked abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) to instruct me with something that I should say in the morning and in the evening. The Imam said say, ‘All praise belongs to Allah, who does as He wills, and does not do what anyone else wants. All praise belongs to Allah, as Allah loves to be praised. All praise belongs to Allah, as He deserves.

O Lord, keep me in every good in which You have kept Muhammad and his family and keep me out of every evil from which You have kept out Muhammad and his family. O Lord, grant al-Salat (favors) upon Muhammad and his family.’”
